patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AWeber and Drip share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose AWeber only if your buying job matches “Creator- and SMB-focused email marketing with free forever, Lite/Plus tiers, and landing p” rather than Drip's shape. Choose Drip only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from” rather than AWeber's shape. Workflow advantage: AWeber leans shared coverage; Drip leans marketing-automation. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AWeber and Drip share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: AWeber is Creator- and SMB-focused email marketing with free forever, Lite/Plus tiers, and landing pages.; Drip is Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pricing from $39/mo..
- Company-size focus: AWeber (micro, small-business) vs Drip (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: AWeber-leaning — vs Drip-leaning marketing-automation.
- Researched limits: AWeber — Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps; Drip — No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo.

Limitations — AWeber: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps; Lite caps lists, LPs, automations, users, and segments vs Plus; Drip: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo; Contact-tier pricing rises as the store list grows.

Poor-fit cases: AWeber is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free: 1 list, limited automations/landing pages, AWeber branding, hard 500-sub / 3k-send caps · Drip is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No forever-free plan — trial-only entry from $39/mo · Avoid AWeber if you actually need Drip's motion (Ecommerce CRM/email platform with behavior-driven automation and contact-tier pr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
